ash-field.direction: A lone armoured knight, small, in silver plate with a blue tabard, red plume and blue shield, stands his ground on a misty grey-blue battlefield of ash, rubble, broken spears and ruined pillars. A colossal charcoal dragon with oxblood wings dives out of the haze, lands, lowers its head and roars, then breathes fire that streams past him; he shields himself without stepping back, then points his sword and steps forward, and the dragon recoils. Cold desaturated cinematic light, haze, embers, enormous scale contrast, low heroic angles, preserving the previs timing and framing.

assets.name: Muse Knight
assets.description: Articulated knight variant of Visitor rig, 1.8m tall. Silver plate torso and limbs, blue tabard front and back, chainmail collar, full helm with visor and red crest plume, brown boots, steel longsword in the right hand and a blue heater shield with a white cross on the left forearm.

assets.name: Ash Dragon
assets.description: Huge charcoal-scaled dragon, about 7 m tall with its neck raised and a 20 m wingspan. Oxblood wing membranes on bony fingers, cream horns, amber eyes, toothed opening jaw. Articulated neck, head, jaw, wings (flap and fold), four legs with knees, body pitch and a six-segment tail.
